title: 长时间游玩后性能下降
description: 随着游戏时间增加，性能逐渐变差，出现卡顿或运行缓慢，可能需要重启游戏恢复。
evidence: the longer you play the game, the worse the performance gets.
It starts small from the moment you load your save and gets worse the more time you play, requiring you to save, close the game and open it again to recover some performance

evidence_items.description: 游戏存在内存管理问题，需要定期重启以清除累积数据
evidence_items.quote_zh: 严重的内存管理问题依然存在。

evidence_items.quote: It starts small from the moment you load your save and gets worse the more time you play, requiring you to save, close the game and open it again to recover some performance
evidence_items.description: 加载存档后性能逐渐恶化，需重启游戏恢复
evidence_items.quote_zh: 从你加载存档的那一刻起，它就开始轻微出现，随着你游玩时间越长就越严重，需要你保存、关闭游戏再重新打开才能恢复一些性能

evidence_items.quote: It seems like the longer I play, the more lag occurs. It gets to the point that it is frustrating to play and I cannot experience later game content.
evidence_items.description: 游玩时间越长延迟越严重，导致无法体验后期内容
evidence_items.quote_zh: 似乎我玩得越久，卡顿就越严重。到了玩起来令人沮丧的地步，我无法体验游戏后期内容。
